thresholdsFrozen.DECLINING: positive breadth <= 0.35 AND weak ratio >= 0.35 AND average change <= -0.5
thresholdsFrozen.MAIN_RISE: positive breadth >= 0.70 AND strong breadth >= 0.35 AND average change >= 1.5
thresholdsFrozen.MATURE: previous stage MAIN_RISE/MATURE AND breadth 0.40-0.75 AND strong breadth <= 0.35 AND average change >= 0.25
thresholdsFrozen.SPROUTING: leader proxy change >= 4.0 AND positive breadth <= 0.45

transitionPolicy: existing persistence/hysteresis unchanged; candidate streak, two-day confirmation, bypass rules, illegal jump hold, and low-confidence hold remain provisional
inputSemantics: formal PIT snapshot/member facts plus exact-date canonical daily-bar evidence; prior shadow result supports persistence
leaderSetSemantics: formal Leader Set authority remains zero; leader is proxy evidence only
